arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions_over_500_credit FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Credit' AND t.amount_usd_cents > 50000
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions over $500 made with credit cards, the same measure as the prepaid-card count.
assumptions: 'Credit' means card_type = 'Credit' exactly, as in the earlier prepaid query.
'Over $500' means amount_usd_cents > 50000, the same threshold as the earlier query.
The count covers all transactions in the data, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, whether or not they have a fraud label.
